expectation: Membrane ring on scattered single mast cells in the mucosa and submucosa. In gut, also a network of interstitial cells of Cajal along the myenteric plexus, between the muscle layers. Rare and specific; epithelium negative.
observed: A: gut sections with a fine yellow line of dots between the muscle layers on both copies, matching the myenteric plexus/ICC, plus scattered mucosal dots. Big round blobs off tissue are debris. B: small ring cells over haze. C: a few bright cells. D: a clear membrane ring on one cell.
why: A distinct set of ring-stained cells is scattered in the mucosa, and a dotted line follows the myenteric plexus in both sections, as cKit-positive mast cells and ICC should.
notes: A dotted cKit line between the muscle layers (ICC at the myenteric plexus) shows in both sections, with scattered ring-shaped mast cells in the mucosa. The large round blobs off the tissue are debris and were not counted.
